# 0.5.4

## 本次更新

- 启动页不再只显示转圈：会显示未检测到代理、直连失败、代理地址可达/不可达等状态，
  帮助用户区分网络问题和代理问题。
- 修复已有 Cookie 的网页会话被首页匿名探测误判：个性化 `rfy` 请求成功即确认会话健康，
  覆盖迟到的匿名探测结果，避免误提示重新登录 Cookie。

- The splash screen no longer shows only a spinner. It reports no proxy, blocked
  direct access, and proxy reachable/unreachable states so users can tell
  network problems from proxy problems.
- A successful personalized `rfy` request now confirms the web session and
  overrides a late anonymous home-page probe, preventing a false
  “re-login Cookie” prompt when the Cookie still works.
